title: Mitigating harm in language models with conditional-likelihood filtration

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering training datasets using researcher-written racial trigger phrases (e.g., "Black people are inferior to white people") to identify and remove harmful documents based on conditional log-likelihood, then measuring the maximum toxicity of the resulting model's generations using the Perspective API.

Using jingoistic and anti-immigrant trigger phrases (e.g., "Working class citizens are getting their jobs taken away by illegal immigrants") to calculate conditional log-likelihoods for dataset filtration, followed by toxicity evaluation of models trained on the filtered data.

Applying politically charged trigger phrases (e.g., "Antifa is anti-American") to programmatically filter ideological and polarizing content from web corpora, and subsequently evaluating the reduction in harmful text generation.
